name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted tracker for movies, shows, books, video games, music and workouts, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: The first account registered becomes the admin. Set USERS_ALLOW_REGISTRATION to false afterwards to close sign-ups.
Movie and show tracking needs a TMDB access token in MOVIES_AND_SHOWS_TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN; other providers such as video games need their own API keys.
